name: CSS Grid Generator
description: Visually build CSS Grid layouts. Drag to create tracks, set gaps, and generate production-ready code.
longDescription: CSS Grid Generator makes complex grid layouts intuitive. Visually define rows and columns by dragging in the canvas. Set gap, alignment, and track sizing (fr, px, %, auto, minmax). See real-time preview with placeholder content. Copy clean CSS with fallbacks. Supports nested grids and named areas.
pricingDetails: Free and open source. No account needed.
